bias.zh: 回调 · 重回 $158 上方，100 日均线在上

read.en: Palantir rose 3.5% on Nov 6 to $160.38, trading $157.24–163.97. It is below the falling 5-day ($168.2), 10-day ($181.6) and 30-day ($190.9) averages and the rising 100-day ($164.3), and above the 200-day ($153.5), which has turned down. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, histogram still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($187.01), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: Palantir 11月6日上涨 3.5%，收于 $160.38，盘中区间 $157.24–163.97。股价位于下行的 5 日（$168.2）、10 日（$181.6）和 30 日均线（$190.9）以及上行的 100 日均线（$164.3）下方，并位于已转为下行的 200 日均线（$153.5）上方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图仍在扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$187.01），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $156.3–158.3 zone (March–April highs, Aug 5 low), now support, after the 200-day held on Nov 5. The $163.97 high stopped under $164.3–164.6 (100-day, Sep 10 and Nov 4 lows). Resistance is $164.3–164.6, then $168.2 (5-day) and $171.7 (Nov 4 close). Support is $156.3–158.3, then $152.6–153.5 (Nov 5 low, 200-day) and $148.6–149.1. A close above $164.6 would target $168–172; below $156.3, $153.

s.en: Apr 8 high $156.28; Mar 17 high $156.75; Aug 5 low $158.25, reclaimed
